description: This source file implements functions for parsing and validating Certificate Revocation Lists (CRLs) in the context of X.509 certificates, including parsing CRL structures, checking revocation status, and handling distribution points and extensions.

classes.name: ParsedCrlTbsCertList
classes.description: Structure representing the parsed TBSCertList part of a CRL, including fields like version, signature algorithm, issuer, update times, extensions, and revoked certificates.

methods.name: ParseCrlCertificateList
methods.description: Parses the entire CRL, extracting the TBSCertList, signature algorithm, and signature value.

methods.name: ParseCrlTbsCertList
methods.description: Parses the TBSCertList component of a CRL, extracting version, signature, issuer, update times, extensions, and revoked certificates.

methods.name: GetCRLStatusForCert
methods.description: Determines the revocation status of a certificate based on the CRL's revoked certificates list.

methods.name: CheckCRL
methods.description: Validates a CRL against a certificate chain, checking signatures, issuer, dates, and revocation status.
